newsitem.title: MONACO: ATHLETICS-BECKFORD SUSPENDED AFTER POSITIVE DRUG TEST.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-BECKFORD SUSPENDED AFTER POSITIVE DRUG TEST.

text.p: Olympic long jump silver medallist James Beckford has been suspended for three months pending a hearing after testing positive for the stimulant ephedrine, the International Amateur Athletic Federation (IAAF) said on Friday.
The Jamaican failed a drug test after placing second at the Paris Grand Prix on June 25.
Under IAAF rules, Beckford now has the opportunity to provide an explanation for the presence of the drug or request analysis of his B sample to confirm the positive test.
Beckford's appeal is not expected to be completed before the world athletics championships which begin on August 1 in Athens, the IAAF said.
